title: Grateful Dead Live at Hilton Hotel on 1969-03-15
lineage: SBD > MC > Cass > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Good audience tape with some hiss/roar that captures a solid show highlighted by a smoking Eleven and an unforgettable Hard to Handle.
ai_review.review: The recording, sourced from Bear’s personal tape stash, isn’t pristine – it has noticeable hiss and occasional roar – but it remains quite listenable. Musically the concert is praised for a stellar rendition of The Eleven and a hard‑to‑miss Hard to Handle (despite mixed feelings about Garcia’s slide), with Dark Star also getting nods. Overall the performance feels honest and humble, even if the early songs are considered weak.

ai_rating.rationale: Five reviews give an average of 3.6 stars; comments highlight strong musical moments (Eleven, Hard to Handle) but note recording hiss and occasional rough songs, leading to a solid‑plus rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Noticeable hiss and roar; not a pristine reel‑sourced tape, but overall clear enough for enjoyment.

show_quality.setlist_flow: An honest, humble performance aimed at the dancing crowd; the set has a strong middle with memorable jams despite a weaker start.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Leads on The Eleven make listeners smile; his slide work on Hard to Handle divides opinion.
band_member_comments.Phil: "Pig's fuckups" are mentioned, indicating bass slip‑ups during the show.
